content:
Alex: Heads-up — need quick sync on continuous-batching fanout vs slice-based latency-slicing tradeoffs. thinking about tail-latency and KV cache coherency.
Priya: tl;dr: fanout = simpler admission but worse headroom; slicing = better tail but complex handoff
Ben: can you sketch the handoff path for slicing? worried about kvcache invalidations
Alex: rough flow:
Alex: 1) request enters, assigned slice id based on deadline
Alex: 2) slice aggregator waits up to window_ms, then flushes slice
Alex: 3) if target GPU busy, slice may be partially executed + preempted -> needs KV checkpoint
Priya: code sketch:
Priya: ```
Priya: if (slice.deadline - now < min_exec) reject_or_degrade();
Priya: if (gpu.free_slots >= slice.size) schedule_direct(slice);
Priya: else attach_to_fanout_queue(slice);
Priya: ```
Marina: attaching to fanout queue means we avoid kvcache juggling but increase latency for majority
Ben: another angle: we could use per-slice semaphores + optimistic kvcache tags to avoid checkpointing
Alex: right — optimistic tags let us skip heavy checkpoint if subsequent slice hits same keys
Priya: But conflict windows with multi-tenant workloads => tags stale -> rollbacks
Marina: ops question: how do we signal preemption to console/telemetry? need events
ops-bot: event: slice_preempted slice_id=0x9f3a node=gpu-17 reason=slot_starvation
Ben: metric proposal: preempt_rate, avg_reexec_tokens, kvcache_miss_delta
Alex: also need a graceful fallback: if slicing fails use fanout fallback with degrade policy
Priya: thoughts on admission: prefer slicing for latency-sensitive routes; fanout for bulk/embeddings
Marina: perf experiment idea: run 10% of traffic in slicing mode with kvcache-tagging enabled, compare p95 and cost
Ben: I'll draft an experiment and a canary plan. any specific SLO guardrails?
Alex: p95 target < 120ms for slicing routes; budget +20% cost. include rollback on p99 regressed
Marina: +1. I'll add telemetry hooks and a dashboard tile.
Priya: one more: need to define slice_size heuristics — tokens vs tokens+context
Alex: agreed. we'll follow up in RFC. thx all :raised_hands:
